title: ZX Bank Ltd. – Salary Saving Account

nodes.title: **Salary Saving Account Features**
nodes.summary: The account offers zero minimum balance, instant account opening, a free international debit card, auto-sweep of surplus into Fixed Deposits, unlimited free IMPS/NEFT/RTGS/UPI transfers, preferential loan rates, bill payments and recharges, and 24x7 help from AI assistant 'Zia'.

nodes.title: **How to Apply for a Salary Saving Account**
nodes.summary: Apply either online (website or ZX Bank Asia app with e-KYC of Aadhaar, PAN, salary slip) or at a branch (opening form, ID/address/PAN/salary slip, biometric KYC).

children.title: Online Steps
children.summary: Visit zxbank.asia or the ZX Bank Asia app, click 'Open Salary Saving Account', complete e-KYC with Aadhaar/PAN/salary slip, fill the application, submit, and receive your account number instantly.

children.title: Branch Process
children.summary: Visit a ZX Bank branch, request the Salary Saving Account Opening Form, submit ID, address proof, PAN, and salary slip, complete biometric/KYC, and receive the account kit and activation confirmation.

nodes.title: **Minimum Balance Requirement**
nodes.summary: Salary Saving Account holders enjoy a true zero minimum balance facility with no penalties for non-maintenance.

nodes.title: **Savings Account Welcome Kit**
nodes.summary: The kit includes a ZX Bank branded travel bag, an international travel adapter (4 plugs for 150 countries with EU/UK/US/AUS plugs and USB ports), a welcome letter with account documents, and an international contactless debit card.

nodes.title: **Need Help?**
nodes.summary: Guidance is available via the ZX Bank Asia app's AI assistant 'Zia', the customer helpline on zxbank.asia, or any branch for personalized assistance.

children.title: Start your salary-led savings journey with ZX Bank and enjoy exclusive banking benefits and exciting gifts!
children.summary: Closing tagline encouraging customers to open a salary-led savings account for banking benefits and gifts.
